top_signals.title: Why Gold Could Reach 5,000
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered’s Suki Cooper joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why gold could resume its climb toward 5,000. She says central-bank demand, geopolitical uncertainty, and portfolio diversification remain powerful supports, while recent price resilience suggests gold has established a durable floor despite higher yields and weak ETF positioning. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
